module_summary: AXI-stream frame joiner: a 3-state FSM emits an optional tag, then forwards one frame from each input port in turn via a port-select mux into a skid-buffered output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/WRITE_TAG/TRANSFER controller sequencing tag emission and per-port frame transfer.

anchors.name: port_sel_reg
anchors.why: Current input port; selects input data/valid/last and ready bit, increments on tlast.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Tag word counter shifting tag out word by word in WRITE_TAG.

anchors.name: output_tuser_reg
anchors.why: Accumulates OR of input tuser across joined frames for final beat.

anchors.name: tag
anchors.why: Tag value prepended to the joined frame in WRITE_TAG.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Level busy output: FSM not idle, via busy_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated input payloads, indexed by port_sel_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-port input valid; starts frame in IDLE, selected in TRANSFER.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-port ready from s_axis_tready_reg, only selected port enabled.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Joined output payload from output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling output/temp transfers.

anchors.name: input_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of currently selected input port; gates transfers in TRANSFER.

anchors.name: input_tlast
anchors.why: Selected port tlast: advances port_sel and ends frame on last port.

anchors.name: input_tdata
anchors.why: Payload of selected input port forwarded to output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output beat: tag word or selected input data.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready gating FSM beat emission and output/temp storing.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early internal ready used for next-cycle input ready.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer payload held while output stalled.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer occupied flag gating early ready.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: internal beat to output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable: internal beat into skid registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: skid registers to output registers.

groups.name: Join controller
groups.description: FSM emitting tag words then sequencing input ports.

groups.name: Input port mux
groups.description: Selects the active input port's stream and ready bit.

groups.name: Skid output register
groups.description: Output register plus temp skid register with transfer enables.
